checks.detail: maxAttestationValidity 900s < measured Base finality 1485s, so a prepare-time decision cannot reach a commit

note: The commit attestations are deliberately not minted here. maxAttestationValidity is an immutable 900s and measured Base economic finality is 1485s, so an attestation created before the wait is expired when the finalized VAA arrives. Commit-time compliance is therefore structural rather than a convention the runner has to remember.
